figurative_meaning_en: To pass off a falsehood as truth
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার ভুলকে রাতকে দিন করে উপস্থাপন করল।
পলিটিশিয়ানরা প্রায়ই সত্যকে রাতকে দিন করে প্রচার করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He presented his mistake as if it were a success, turning night into day.
Politicians often pass off lies as truth in their speeches.
